signal: Celigo was named the only 2025 Gartner Peer Insights Customers' Choice for iPaaS and launched API Builder, expanding past 200 connectors.

email.body1:
Kari, saw Celigo took the only 2025 Gartner Customers' Choice spot for iPaaS and shipped API Builder.

Recognition like that floods the funnel with more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Celigo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kari, quick follow-up for Celigo.

With 4,000-plus customers and rising demand, pipeline expectations tend to outrun what headcount can absorb. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Celigo needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kari, last bit of proof for Celigo.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Celigo's reply rate likely compares to peer iPaaS vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kari, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Riding that kind of momentum is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Celigo either way.
